or_fail.sql: UPDATE OR FAIL t SET a = 1;

or_ignore.sql: UPDATE OR IGNORE t SET a = 1;

or_replace.sql: UPDATE OR REPLACE t SET a = 1;

or_rollback.sql: UPDATE OR ROLLBACK t SET a = 1;

order_by_limit.sql: UPDATE t SET a = 0 WHERE b = 1 ORDER BY c LIMIT 10;

returning.sql: UPDATE t SET a = a + 1 RETURNING a, b;

schema_qualified_alias.sql: UPDATE main.t AS x SET a = 1 WHERE x.b = 2;

where.sql: UPDATE t SET a = a + 1 WHERE b = 2;

with_cte.sql: WITH q AS (SELECT id FROM u) UPDATE t SET a = 0 WHERE id IN q;

do_nothing.sql: INSERT INTO t (a) VALUES (1) ON CONFLICT (a) DO NOTHING;

do_nothing_no_target.sql: INSERT INTO t (a) VALUES (1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

do_update.sql: INSERT INTO t (a, b) VALUES (1, 2) ON CONFLICT (a) DO UPDATE SET b = excluded.b;

do_update_column_list_set.sql: INSERT INTO t (a, b, c) VALUES (1, 2, 3) ON CONFLICT (a) DO UPDATE SET (b, c) = (excluded.b, excluded.c);

do_update_multiple_set.sql: INSERT INTO t (a, b, c) VALUES (1, 2, 3) ON CONFLICT (a) DO UPDATE SET b = excluded.b, c = c + 1;

do_update_no_target.sql: INSERT INTO t (a, b) VALUES (1, 2) ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET b = excluded.b;

do_update_where.sql: INSERT INTO t (a, b) VALUES (1, 2) ON CONFLICT (a) DO UPDATE SET b = excluded.b WHERE excluded.b > t.b;

multiple_clauses.sql: INSERT INTO t (a, b) VALUES (1, 2) ON CONFLICT (a) DO UPDATE SET b = excluded.b ON CONFLICT (b) DO NOTHING ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

select_source_where_true.sql: INSERT INTO t SELECT * FROM u WHERE true ON CONFLICT (a) DO UPDATE SET b = excluded.b;

target_collate_order.sql: INSERT INTO t (a) VALUES ('x') ON CONFLICT (a COLLATE NOCASE ASC) DO NOTHING;

target_multiple_columns.sql: INSERT INTO t (a, b) VALUES (1, 2) ON CONFLICT (a, b) DO NOTHING;

target_where.sql: INSERT INTO t (a, b) VALUES (1, 2) ON CONFLICT (a) WHERE b IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET b = excluded.b;

with_returning.sql: INSERT INTO t (a, b) VALUES (1, 2) ON CONFLICT (a) DO UPDATE SET b = excluded.b RETURNING a, b;

basic.sql: WITH q AS (SELECT c FROM t) SELECT c FROM q;

column_list.sql: WITH q(x, y) AS (SELECT a, b FROM t) SELECT x, y FROM q;

compound_main_query.sql: WITH q AS (SELECT a FROM t) SELECT a FROM q UNION SELECT a FROM u;

cte_values_body.sql: WITH q(x) AS (VALUES (1), (2)) SELECT x FROM q;

in_cte_name.sql: WITH q(n) AS (SELECT a FROM t) SELECT c FROM u WHERE c IN q;

materialized.sql: WITH q AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c FROM t) SELECT c FROM q;

multiple.sql: WITH q1 AS (SELECT a FROM t), q2 AS (SELECT a FROM q1) SELECT a FROM q2;

not_materialized.sql: WITH q AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT c FROM t) SELECT c FROM q;

recursive_multiple_recursive_selects.sql: WITH RECURSIVE r(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION SELECT a FROM t JOIN r ON b = x UNION SELECT b FROM t JOIN r ON a = x) SELECT x FROM r;

recursive_order_limit.sql: WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM r ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT n FROM r;

recursive_union.sql: WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (VALUES (1) UNION SELECT n + 1 FROM r WHERE n < 5) SELECT n FROM r;

recursive_union_all.sql: WITH RECURSIVE cnt(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x + 1 FROM cnt WHERE x < 10) SELECT x FROM cnt;
